repos_data.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
Recordings in. Agent-ready evidence out. Local-first MCP for transcripts, keyframes, OCR, speakers, and wall-clock evidence.

Your coding agent makes the demo video — a narrated, captioned MP4 from one storyboard.json. Deterministic replay re-renders it in CI (no key, ~$0). Open-source (MIT) alternative to Screen Studio / Clueso / Demosmith.
Screenshots by Ciro Cesar Maciel: an open screenshot and screen recording app for the Mac, in the spirit of CleanShot X. Native Swift, no network code.

Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
